#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string dna;
    std::cin >> dna;
    int count = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < dna.length(); ) {
        char current = dna[i];
        int runLength = 0;
        
        while (i < dna.length() && dna[i] == current) {
            runLength++;
            i++;
        }
        
        if (runLength % 2 == 0) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
